'''Juranai''' is an [[Aiel]] leader of the [[Red Shield]] society.

== Appearance ==
He is slender with pale streaks of white in his brown hair.

== Activities ==
He is present when the Aiel begin their attack on the [[Shaido]] who are laying siege to [[Cairhien]].
